scenes.title: How to wash your hands
scenes.subtitle: Kitchen hygiene · 6 steps
scenes.narration: Clean hands stop germs from reaching food. Here is how to wash them correctly.

scenes.heading: Before you start
items: Roll your sleeves up to the elbow
scenes.narration: Before you start, remove rings and watches, roll your sleeves up and use the hand-wash sink only.

scenes.text: Wet your hands with *warm running water*
scenes.narration: Step one: wet your hands with warm running water.
Step two: apply liquid soap from the dispenser.

scenes.label: Scrub for at least *20 seconds*
scenes.narration: Step three: scrub palms, backs, fingers and nails for at least twenty seconds.
Step four: rinse under running water, fingertips pointing down.

scenes.dont_text: Never dry your hands on your *apron*
scenes.narration: Step five: dry with a single-use paper towel. Never dry your hands on your apron.

scenes.question: How long should you scrub your hands?
scenes.narration: Quick quiz: how long should you scrub your hands?

scenes.question: How long should you scrub your hands?
scenes.explanation: Scrub for at least 20 seconds before you rinse.
scenes.narration: Correct answer: at least twenty seconds.

scenes.heading: Clean hands, safe food
scenes.narration: Remember: wet, soap, scrub for twenty seconds, rinse, and dry with a single-use towel.
